'''Cornevero Dawlton''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Cornevero Dawlton]]
Cornevero Dawlton was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Cornevero Dawlton spawned under the generic "commoner" template, Dawlton's appearance was randomized under one of a 120 possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Dawlton could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either [[Gender/Legends|gender]], and male [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] and male [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]]. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue made no mention of Dawlton's physical characteristics, the [[canon]]ical species and gender cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
